trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: I object to pay this fee.
trap.right: I object to paying this fee.
trap.why: Em português “me oponho a pagar” é infinitivo. Em inglês, object to e be opposed to terminam em preposição, então vem -ing.

fix.wrong: They object to open on Sundays.
fix.right: They object to opening on Sundays.

fix.wrong: She is opposed with the plan.
fix.right: She is opposed to the plan.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I don’t want to pay.” (object to)
Reescreva: “He opposes working late.” (is opposed to)
rewrite.answer: He is opposed to working late.
